manifest.name: @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review
manifest.description: Maestro Review for the DeepSeek Harness: GitLab webhook intake, project mappings with local worktrees, the Settings section and Telegram digests, on top of the maestro-reviewer engine

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/build-client.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh-maestro-review bundle patch: the DSH host rows of Maestro Review. The
# engine rows (maestro-review-host, maestro-review-engine) come from the
# @ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer bundle, which the profile lists too.
# RPC channel: /dsh-maestro-review (see src/host/settings-rpc.ts)
- insert:
    # The package root. DSH serves a package's dsh.client bundle (the Settings
    # section) only when a row names the bare package; subpath rows below do
    # not register it. apply() itself registers nothing.
    - id: maestro-review-plugin
      name: '@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review'
    # GitLab webhook intake on the raw webserver (/hooks/gitlab-mr*).
    - id: maestro-review-webhook
      name: '@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review/lib/providers/gitlab.js'
      config:
        secret: !!js process.env.MAESTRO_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
        botUsername: maestro-bot
    # Settings, mappings, trigger gates and worktrees, then the engine.
    - id: maestro-review-host-orchestrator
      name: '@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review/lib/host-orchestrator.js'
      inject: ['reviewEngine', 'agentDefaultModel']
      config:
        gitlabBaseUrl: https://gitlab.example.com
        gitlabToken: !!js process.env.MAESTRO_GITLAB_TOKEN
        botUsername: maestro-bot
        projectMappings: []
    - id: maestro-review-settings-rpc
      name: '@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review/lib/settings-rpc.js'
      # rpc.handle registers a webServer route inside an effect fiber which carries only the row's inject (not the module's);
      # on DSH 0.2.x that is not sufficient on its own, see the `connection` entry at the end of this file.
      inject: ['connection', 'webServer']

# DSH 0.2.x resolves `webServer` for `ctx.connection.rpc.handle` on the
# `connection` row own fiber, so a row-level inject cannot reach it. `inject`
# replaces the base list, hence `webStartup` (the base row needs it for
# trustedHosts) is repeated. Identical in every maestro package that registers
# RPC channels, so each one stays installable alone.
- id: connection
  inject:
    - webStartup
    - webServer

readme.text:
Maestro Review on a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) web host: GitLab webhook intake, project mappings with local worktrees,
the Maestro Review Settings section and Telegram review digests. Every review
runs through the engine of [`@ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer`](https://github.com/ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer),
which also carries the GitLab CI flow.

- **Webhook intake** (row `maestro-review-webhook`): `/hooks/gitlab-mr` on the
  raw DSH webserver, authenticated by `X-Gitlab-Token`. An `@<bot>` mention
  asks for a quick review, `/maestro deep` or "deep review" for a deep one;
  reviewer assignment and pushes trigger reviews when enabled. A note whose
  first line is `/maestro explain`, `/maestro fix` (in a finding thread) or
  `/maestro rereview [path]` is answered right away, with the engine's access
  rules (Developer or above) and answer markers, the same as in CI.
- **Host orchestrator** (row `maestro-review-host-orchestrator`): reads the
  settings, applies the trigger gates, prunes history, and calls the engine's
  `reviewEngine` service. A mapped project is reviewed on a worktree of its
  local checkout (vendor and `app/etc/env.php` linked, a per-MR govard
  environment for the deep auditor, torn down afterwards); a missing branch
  falls back to a diff-only review. An unmapped project gets a diff-only
  review on mention and a "Not started" note for deep. Every review reads the
  project's `.maestro-review.yml` from its default branch (ignore globs,
  rules, minimum severity, language; fan-out only when the file sets i

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-review
```

Both packages are needed: the engine rows (`maestro-review-host`,
`maestro-review-engine`) come from `@ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer`.

```sh
pnpm --dir ../../maestro-reviewer build   # the engine's lib/ first
pnpm install
pnpm verify
pnpm build    # host lib/ plus the client bundle lib/client.js
